parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the main refrigerator door made of stainless steel, forming the front access panel.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the refrigerator compartment and provides insulation to maintain internal temperature.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the secondary refrigerator door, likely for the freezer compartment, made of stainless steel.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the freezer section and maintains cold air containment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis similar to the main door.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the structural frame of the refrigerator, made of steel, providing rigidity and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other components and maintains the overall shape and stability of the refrigerator.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: This part includes the control panel and buttons, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to adjust temperature, modes, and other refrigerator settings.
parts.Movement_description: It contains small movable buttons or touch-sensitive areas for user input.

parts.name: Other (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is an auxiliary component, possibly a decorative or functional panel, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a cover or housing for internal components or aesthetic enhancement.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed and does not move during normal operation.
